familySummary: Meta storage cabinets offer a compact upright form in 100 × 40 × 118 cm, suited to everyday storage in a living or dining space.
familyDescription: The Meta storage cabinet family combines a tall, slim profile with practical closed storage for rooms that need organisation without taking up much floor space. Both cabinets measure 100 × 40 × 118 cm and are made from MDF, Wood veneer. One version is finished in Brown, giving a darker look, while the other keeps a more natural appearance. Use them for storing tableware, books, office items, or other household essentials where a neat cabinet is preferred.
